cohort: 71 neonates born to women with COVID-19 diagnosed at the end of pregnancy
finding: Maternal COVID-19 diagnosis close to delivery was associated with a higher incidence of cesarean delivery, preterm birth, and neonatal interventions such as respiratory support.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the main route of delivery (84.5%), with the primary indications being pregnant women with critical disease (24.6%) and acute fetal distress (20.3%).
